# Y Combinator Search Jobs

List job openings at YC companies from workatastartup.com, filtered by role category. Returns up to 30 jobs per call with title, salary range, location, and company info.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/ycombinator/search-jobs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

This API runs asynchronously. The call returns a task `id` with status `pending`; poll `GET https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run/{id}` until `status` is `completed` and read the result from `outputs[0].data`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | string | No | Role category filter. Accepted values: 'software-engineer', 'designer', 'recruiting', 'science', 'product', 'operations', 'sales', 'marketing', 'legal', 'finance'. Also accepts aliases: 'eng' or 'engi… |

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls are not charged.
